articles.headline: Pakistani national killed, 11 wounded as Riyadh airport hit by Houthi strike
articles.summary: AI summary: Saudi aviation authorities said a projectile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Sunday killed a Pakistani resident and injured 11 people, a day after an earlier Houthi-claimed attack there that officials said left 12 dead. The airport's closure was extended, and the Houthis have threatened further strikes on Saudi transport hubs.

articles.summary: AI summary: The family of a Pakistani ship engineer killed in a September attack on a tanker off Oman is pressing for his body to be brought home, saying they have had no clear answer from officials. The Foreign Office has said the remains are held in an Omani mortuary pending DNA identification, but the family says no sample has yet been taken from them.

articles.summary: AI summary: The Pakistan Textile Exporters Association warned that goods exports will fall sharply in the October to December quarter, blaming weak Western demand, freight costs up to two and a half times higher and rising production costs. It asked the government for temporary duty drawback support, release of pending refunds, removal of energy cross-subsidies and implementation of the announced export finance rate.

articles.headline: Emergency, governor's rule imposed in KP as President Zardari approves summary on PM's advice
articles.summary: AI summary: President Asif Ali Zardari approved the federal cabinet's advice to impose an emergency and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa under Articles 232 and 234, with the government citing security conditions and the collapse of talks with the PTI-led provincial leadership. Governor Faisal Karim Kundi will run the province with an 11-member advisory council, while PTI and other parties denounced the step as undemocratic and vowed a court challenge.

political.reason: Suspending an elected provincial government is a major shock to federal-provincial relations and institutional stability.

social.reason: Troop deployment, reported internet disruption and school closures affect residents' daily lives.
